question: Should ClawHub export and persist the experimental `claw` package-family contract before the Claws RFC and the remaining gated publication/read stack are accepted?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent but creates a shared and persisted compatibility boundary; only maintainers can decide whether that boundary should land independently and remain unstable behind a deployment gate.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep this PR draft, finalize the Claw v1 contract in the RFC, then rebase and validate this schema against the accepted model before merging.

options.title: Approve staged storage contract
options.body: Explicitly accept the exported and persisted contract now while requiring the feature gate and strict PR ordering before any Claw publication or visibility ships.

options.title: Review the stack atomically
options.body: Assess this schema together with the publication, discovery, and feed PRs so compatibility and disabled-state behavior are approved as one rollout.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep this PR draft, finalize the Claw v1 contract in the RFC, then rebase and validate this schema against the accepted model before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for the Claws product model and compatibility shape based on the linked RFC review history.
